claims.text: Self-vows generally lose their benefit on breach; mutual-vow penalties are unspecified. Disclosure and overtime are vow examples.
Ratio is an innate 7:3 weak-point technique. Restoring chants/gestures is ritual execution, not automatically a vow.

The Culling Game has trapped participants and rule changes bought with points; a trial domain has confiscation rules that can take a tool first.
Allowing domain escape buys wider sure-hit scope. Yuji agrees to timed body control and forgetting.
The later Enchain loophole excludes harm to Yuji himself because of how he understood anyone; exact translation not read.
